Complete Platform Overview

Built to Streamline School Operations

TELOS is a complete management solution built to bring together student records, staff management, attendance, assessments, report cards, timetables, and administrative operations into one simple platform. The goal of TELOS is to reduce paperwork, improve accuracy, and give schools better tools for decision making.

Student Management

Comprehensive directory tracking student profiles, guardians, medical data, and classes.

Staff Management

Maintain staff records, designations, credentials, qualifications, and emergency contacts.

Attendance Tracking

Monitor attendance, term days opened, present/absent logs, and generate summaries.

Assessment Management

Input test scores, projects, and examinations with automated grade scaling and computations.

Report Cards

Generate standardized terminal performance report cards with one-click PDF export.

Timetable Management

Organize class schedules, exam timetables, and weekly teacher duty rosters cleanly.

Administrative Control

Robust multi-role permissions, user setups, academic year configurations, and student promotions.

Document Submissions

Teachers submit weekly lesson notes, termly forecasts, and examination papers for secure administrative review.

Our Story

Built From Real Classroom Experience

TELOS was not created only from software ideas. It was inspired by years of experience within the Ghanaian education environment. The developers behind TELOS have spent several years working within education, understanding the daily challenges faced by teachers, administrators, and school owners.

Challenge 01

Large Student Records

Managing bulky physical files and large volumes of student bio data without data loss.

Challenge 02

Tracking Academic Performance

Eliminating manual score compilation errors and standardizing continuous assessment computations.

Challenge 03

Preparing Reports

Saving teachers hours of stressful terminal report card handwriting and formatting.

Challenge 04

Organizing Attendance

Keeping track of school days opened, student presence, and absenteeism accurately.

Challenge 05

Handling Administrative Tasks

Reducing bureaucratic bottlenecks across fee collection, staff duty rosters, and timetables.

Challenge 06

Manual Paperwork Dependency

Transitioning schools securely to a digital ecosystem that handles lesson notes and submissions.

The Core Bridge

Support

Admin Quick Start Guide

New to TELOS? Here's the fastest path to getting your school fully set up as an Administrator.

1

Sign In As Administrator

Log in with your admin email and password. Only the Administrator account can access Dashboard, Settings, and school-wide configuration.

2

Complete Academic Setup

Under Settings → Academic Setup, set your School Type, Academic Year, Terms, and Grading System first — everything else builds on this.

3

Create Classes & Streams

Set up each class and stream your school runs (e.g. JHS 1A, JHS 1B) under Classes & Streams Management.

4

Add Staff & Assign Roles

Add teachers in Staff Directory, then assign each one as a Class Teacher and/or Subject Teacher under Subject Configuration & Assignment.

5

Add Students

Add students one at a time, or download the CSV/Excel template in Student Directory to bulk-add your whole roll at once.

6

Build Timetables

Set up each class's weekly timetable under the Timetable tab. Staff automatically see the timetables for their own class and subjects.

7

Track Scores & Attendance

Once the term is running, teachers enter scores and attendance is logged. You can review progress anytime from the Dashboard.

8

Generate Report Cards

At the end of term, generate, preview and download report cards individually, in bulk, or from the archived history — all as ready-to-print PDFs.

Academic Setup & Structure

Manage academic years, terms, classes with flexible streams, and curriculum subjects.

Academic Years

Academic Year Name Start Date End Date Status Action

Terms Setup

When a term ends, click Lock & Archive to snapshot every student's scores, attendance and remarks into Academic History and clear the score sheet for the next term. This cannot be undone. Once locked, a term can be Hidden from this list to keep it tidy -- its Academic History snapshot stays intact either way, and hidden terms can be brought back with "Show hidden terms".

Term Name Academic Year Start Date End Date Status Ranking Archive Action

The date the next term reopens. Enter it here once the reopening date is confirmed.

Classes & Streams Management

Supports grade levels with flexible streams (e.g., JHS 1A, JHS 1B, Science, Arts, or empty stream).

Generated Class Name Grade Level Stream Class Teacher Max Capacity Enrolled Status Action

Subject Configuration & Assignment

Teachers are assigned per class. Use "Edit" on any row to change a subject, its classes or its teachers, or "Assign Subjects to Class Teacher" to give a class teacher several subjects in the class they lead.

Subject Name Code Department Assigned Classes Assigned Teachers Status Action

Grading Scale & Remarks

Set the score range, grade and remark for each band. It applies to the score sheets, student profiles and report cards. Terms already locked in Academic History keep the grades they were archived with.

From (%) To (%) Grade Remark Action

Ranges are whole percentages and must cover 0–100 with no gaps or overlaps. A total such as 79.5 stays in the band that contains 79 (it is never rounded up).

Report Card Quick Picks

Set up your list of Conducts, Interests and Remarks once. On the Report Card you can then pick from these lists instead of typing every time (you can still type or edit a field by hand). Editing or deleting a quick pick here does not change report cards you have already filled in.
